text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was the day of the monthly big cleanup 
at the Ritto Dorm. When Admire Groove 
arrived at her assigned area...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...? That's—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No no no no no! No waaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um... please. Won't you clean up 
together with everyone?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san, the dorm mother is going to 
scold you, you know...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I don't care about that! Cleaning can 
wait until next time!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm busy with my magic research! If you 
want to do that, just go do it with Alv!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Ah, Ms. Alve...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! What? Glaring at me isn't gonna make 
me back down!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Haven't you realized it yet?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
How cleaning this room will affect the 
magic...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Wait, what do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm asking you if this cleaning really has 
nothing to do with your magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's just...! ...Wait, hold on...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I remember the grimoire 
saying, "Magic power gathers in purified 
spaces"...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
We've got no time to lose! Alv, Still, 
give me a hand! We're doing a full spring 
cleaning right now!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Alright, dusting is completely finished!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Still! I'll wipe the windows. With 
sunlight like this, it wouldn't be good 
for you to get too much of it, right?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Fufu, thank you very much. I'm 
sorry, I'm not good with strong 
sunlight... In that case, please leave the 
space under the sofa to me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Not a bad pace. Let's keep progressing 
efficiently like this.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, it's squeaky clean in no time 
at all...! Thank you so much for your hard 
work, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Not good enough! I can't pull off 
extra-large magic like this!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"If we're gonna do this, the whole dorm 
has to be spotless! Just you wait, I'm 
cleaning every single corner!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'll take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, yes. ...Alve-san, thank you so much 
for today."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you actually got Sweep-san 
into it... It's almost like real magic.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Not really. I'm just used to it.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh... What do you mean, "used to it"...?

text_block_list.name: Facility Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry, Alve-san. Would you mind 
keeping an eye on this child for a 
bit...?"

text_block_list.name: Young Alv
text_block_list.text: "Yes, understood."

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
"‘No, no! I don't wanna study anymore! I 
wanna go play outside~!’"

text_block_list.name: Young Alv
text_block_list.text:
"I see. What a shame... And I had a reward 
ready for you once we finished, too."

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh?! ...W-What do you mean, a 
reward...?"

text_block_list.name: Young Alv
text_block_list.text:
"‘What good does knowing do? You won't get 
it unless you actually do it.’"

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'll do it right, you know! Alright~, 
time to give it my all~...!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "It's nothing. ...Forget it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Near the hollow of a great tree, I spotted 
Sweep Tosho and the others talking to 
Admire Groove.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez! That's why I've been telling you—I 
need your help!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's an ultimate spell combining the magic 
of all three of us! Just go along with it 
already~!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... Sweep insisted that it 
absolutely had to be you and me...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I don't know. Don't drag me into this.
choice_data_list: Sweep seems unusually fond of you.
Why don't you help her together?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It's only temporary anyway. ...Excuse 
me."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Geez! *I'm* the one who sees 
potential in you. You should feel a little 
honored, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hold on! I am neeeever gonna give up 
on you, you hear me~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why me? ...You could have just declined, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... since Arve is with me... I 
thought, maybe it'll be okay...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ………… No, it has nothing to do with me.
